description: A COPY statement whose text-name-1 is not qualified by a library-name while another COBOL library is available (§2002:7.1.2.3 GR3: "When neither library-name-1 nor literal-2 is specified, a default COBOL library is used"). ANSI X3.23-1985 required the qualification (§1985:XII.2.3 SR1: "If more than one COBOL library is available during compilation, text-name-1 must be qualified by library-name-1"); ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 38 lists the relaxation as a 2002 change ("When more than one COBOL library is referenced, text-name need not be qualified when the library text resides in the default library"). The libraries available during a compilation are the DOC-A.1-40 determination: the default library and each library a COPY statement of the compilation group names with OF or IN that a library place holds. The introduction gate is CopyProcessor.ResolveOneCopy, reported at each unqualified COPY statement once a second library is available (kb/Work PB5473).
display: a COPY statement with an unqualified text-name while more than one COBOL library is available
